name: Camp Wildcat 2.0 (Teen Camp)
operator_name: University of New Hampshire Youth Programs
description_short: A weekly day camp for teens entering grades 8-10. It is part of UNH's Camp Wildcat but follows its own schedule, with hikes, beach trips, visits to Mendums Pond and amusement parks, and time exploring the UNH campus. Days run 8:15am-4:15pm.
refund_policy_summary: Payment is due in full when you enroll. There is also a non-refundable $10 registration fee per student. Drop or transfer requests made 15 or more days before the session starts are refunded minus an administrative fee of at least $75. Requests made 14 or fewer days before the start get no refund. If UNH cancels the session, you get a full refund.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons are offered as Extended Care, only for campers enrolled in the matching Camp Wildcat 2.0 session. Trips include beaches and Mendums Pond.
